text:
Zara (Partnerships): 72h prelaunch scrub for marketplace listing + joint GTM. Keep it to blockers only.
Ben (Product): Listing copy locked. Need final hero treatment and partner quote for the listing header.
Kira (Marketing): Hero art finished for EN, mobile crop done. Locales (PT/IT) are low priority, will ship later. Can we go EN-first?
Zara (Partnerships): Yes but hero must not reflow. Marco, confirm the marketplace template handles hot-swap without layout shifts.
Marco (Platform): It does. We'll push the asset as a single source of truth; swapping locale just replaces the same-size file. No layout change expected.
Hugo (Engineering): SI onboarding tests pass. Small caveat: tenant-provision returns 429 under heavy parallel onboarding in ap-south-1. Adding client-side backoff.
Ben (Product): Who owns partner landing copy? I'll take it if Hugo provides the 3-step integration snippet and a quick FAQ.
Hugo (Engineering): Snippet: ```bash
# create tenant
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/tenants -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"name":"partner-tenant","region":"ap-south-1"}'
```
Add note: "If you receive 429, retry after 3s".
Kira (Marketing): Embargo set 10:30am PT Thursday so partner press can coordinate. Blog + press + partner email to go live together.
Zara (Partnerships): Logos: PartnerOps, please confirm we have vector logos and alt text for accessibility. Any legal holds?
PartnerOps: Sent vector logos for 5 partners. Still waiting on Altisys brand kit.
LegalBot: Altisys requires signed co-marketing addendum. Deadline EOD tomorrow or we remove them from hero.
Ben (Product): Contingency captured: if Altisys misses kit, remove from hero and include in partner page.
Marco (Platform): Preflight scheduled 05:00 PT tomorrow. I'll validate redirect chain (listing -> partner landing -> signup), CDN purge, and the image swap path.
Kira (Marketing): UTM pattern: ?utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=q3_launch&utm_content=partner_name
Hugo (Engineering): Deployed retry/backoff patch to staging. CI green.
Marco (Platform): Preflight done: redirect chain clean, CDN purge successful, image swap validated. Observed sporadic 429s during a synthetic spike but client retry handled them. Marking as green-with-note.
LegalBot: Altisys addendum received and approved during thread. All legal checks clear.
Zara (Partnerships): Excellent. Final go/no-go call Monday 09:00 PT. Keep this thread for blockers only. If anything breaks overnight ping me directly. :rocket:
